title: NANSEN project
description: The project file, project.nansen.json, at the root of a project folder. It names the project and declares its entity types. Paths are relative to the project folder.

$schema.description: Optional pointer for editors. Readers ignore it.

name.description: Short identifier of the project. Unlike the dev branch, it does not name a MATLAB package, so renaming a project does not break code.

dataset.description: Path to the project's Dataset Structure Model config, relative to the project folder. The config's entity types define identity; a table's key is the identity of the entity's ancestors and its own. Root paths in the config that are not absolute are relative to the config's folder.

modules.description: Modules the project uses, in order of precedence. A module without a path is looked up in the project's modules/ folder, then among the modules that ship with NANSEN.

path.description: Module folder, absolute or relative to the project folder.

entityTypes.description: The entity types this project keeps tables for. Each one has a table at tables/<name>.table.nansen.json.

name.description: Name of the entity type. Once a DSM config is attached, it must match an entity type there; the DSM entity type defines identity.

fragments.description: Fragments (column groups) this entity type carries, by id. A fragment with id 'a.b' is defined in fragments/a.b.fragment.nansen.json, or by one of the project's modules.
